summary: Independent-verification-only phase, following Phase 149O.20L.7O.2N.7's recommendation. Independently re-derived HRWP-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/HATP_REMOTE_WEBAUTHN_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.md) from primary contracts (HHCE-001 v1.1, HPSE-001 v1.1, HSCE-001 v1.3, HBDC-001 v1.2, HATP-001 v1.0) and current production source (hatp_fido2_provider.py, hatp_providers.py, hatp_hardware_credentials.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, hatp_signing_ceremony.py) rather than trusting 2N.7's own report, tests, or conclusions. Re-confirmed requirement-numbering completeness (HRWP-REQ-001-068, sequential, no gaps/duplicates); re-derived the central cryptographic claim directly from source (authenticatorData||SHA-256(clientDataJSON), the standard WebAuthn assertion construction, with origin/RP-ID enforcement as the only genuine local/remote divergence -- not an arbitrary-message-signing scheme); confirmed the HRWP-001/HSCE-001 authority boundary is correctly drawn (HRWP owns the cryptographic profile, a future HSCE-001 companion is correctly named -- not bypassed -- for ceremony/evidence-capture orchestration); confirmed multi-credential/multi-signer/DeploymentBinding semantics, EXPLICIT_SIGNER policy, transport independence, and RP-ID/origin semantic-vs-literal distinction all hold under independent re-derivation. One Non-Blocking finding: HRWP-REQ-019's 'no schema widening' claim for protocol_name='WEBAUTHN' is inaccurate -- hatp_hardware_credentials.py enforces a closed _PROTOCOL_VALUES = frozenset({'FIDO2','PIV'}) allowlist in code (contradicting HHCE-REQ-002's 'plain string field' description HRWP-REQ-019 relies on), so a real WebAuthn-sourced registration would be rejected until that frozenset is widened -- a narrow, one-line future code change, not an architectural or security defect. No other finding, Blocking or Non-Blocking, survived independent re-derivation. 10 freshly authored independent tests (not copied from 2N.7), all passing. No production source or contract text changed. No makeCredential/getAssertion against real hardware anywhere. Verdict: HRWP-001 v1.0 INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED WITH ONE NON-BLOCKING FINDING -- IMPLEMENTATION PREREQUISITES MAY PROCEED.
